Pope Francis to undergo no further cancer treatment after surgery

Pope Francis, aged 71, will not require further treatment after undergoing surgery for lung cancer. Doctors have stated that no additional therapy is needed following the procedure. The Pope has commenced a gradual return to his duties and is expected to proceed with a planned visit to Uruguay, Argentina, and Peru from November 6 to 17.
